# proxmox_storage_rrddata (Data Source)

Reads raw storage RRD points from `/nodes/{node}/storage/{storage}/rrddata`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "proxmox_storage_rrddata" "d" {
  node      = "pve-1"
  storage   = "local"
  timeframe = "hour"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `node` (String)
- `storage` (String)
- `timeframe` (String)

### Optional

- `cf` (String)

### Read-Only

- `data` (String)
